cooking utensils, tableware) — Smart TV (55”) with Roku streaming — Central heat and A/C — In-unit washer and dryer — Free WiFi — 2,102 sq. ft. Exterior: — Gas grill — Fire pit — Balcony — Outdoor dining area (patio table & chairs) — Beach chairs — On-site parking for 2 cars (driveway only; no street parking)NeighborhoodThis home is located in a quiet, well-maintained community just south of scenic Highway 30A. Guests love the convenience—walk to the beach in under 5 minutes or ride the included bikes to shops, seafood spots, and parks nearby. Seaside, Eastern Lake, and Grayton Beach are all a short drive or ride away.TransitNo car required for daily beach access or nearby dining. For grocery runs or longer outings, a car is recommended. Please observe all community parking guidelines.AccessGuests will have access to the entire home, including the outdoor dining area, fire pit, grill, washer and dryer, and garage storage for beach gear. Parking is available for 2 vehicles in the driveway. No street parking is allowed due to fire code.NotesPlease keep in mind that if you plan to swim or sunbathe, you are responsible for checking beach conditions and public access rules.
